facts.fact: UNESCO reports that regulators and policymakers from Guinea-Bissau, with Angola, Sao Tome and Principe and Mozambique (more than 40 in all), took part in a data governance workshop in Maputo on 8-10 December 2025, organised by UNESCO with Mozambique's INTIC and Smart Africa; attendance only, no agreement signed.
